profile_text.body:
Xello describes itself as a K-12 college and career readiness platform that helps students build personalized pathways, supports educators with insights, and gives districts tools to strengthen future readiness at scale. The site directs teachers, students, and parents to sign in at login.xello.world using credentials from their district, and invites districts interested in the program to connect with a counselor or career advisor to set up a demo.

The company's tracked product is also named Xello, listed under education and research AI with career matching as its AI function. It is used for career and college readiness in K-12 by students and counselors, with student access tied to school accounts. Pricing is per student by quote, with different tiers for elementary, middle, and high school, per a vendor statement on G2. The product was found in research for The AI Ready School and has not been independently verified, and its privacy practices were not verified.

The available record contains no lawsuits, no MCP servers, and no SEC or patent facts for the company.
